minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  June 06, 2022

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 868 2420 3396 Passcode: 017243 at 9:36 am.
  Members Present:  Bianca Plascencia, Finance Department
  Mark Weinberg, Administration
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes –Parks and Rec
  Ana Ma – Police
  Adrianna Grimes – Public Works
  Aisha Thompson – City Clerk

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of May 23, 2022, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Continental Binder & Specialty Corp. – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for providing printing services for Super Bowl LVI for the Inglewood Police
  Department in the amount of $3,410.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Communication Technology Services, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for Communication Technology Services for the Police Department during
  Super Bowl LVI in the amount of $5,085.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. RJ’s Demolition & Disposal- Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  services provided to the City in the amount of $2,196.65. Motion carried unanimously.

  5. Beaux Marie Designs - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  event planning services for the Document Shredding Event for the City in the amount
  of $5,029.40. Motion carried unanimously.

  6. MCA Direct - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing election
  consulting services and supplies in the amount of $1,508.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 10:05 a.m.
Adjournment
